items.title: File Widerspruch against pension rejection
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch zulässig.
items.computation: Letter is dated 18.11.2026 (Wednesday); assuming this is also the day of 'Aufgabe zur Post' (not separately stated). The letter specifies its own delivery fiction: 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben' -> 18.11.2026 + 4 days = 22.11.2026 (Sunday). This deemed-notice day is a fiction about when the Bescheid counts as known, not itself a deadline to perform an act, so it is not shifted for falling on a Sunday. The one-month Widerspruch period then runs from that Bekanntgabe day per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (analogous in social law): the day of Bekanntgabe (22.11.2026) is not counted, the period starts 23.11.2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 22.12.2026 (Tuesday). 22.12.2026 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Final deadline: 22.12.2026.

warnings: The deemed-delivery rule stated in the letter ('vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post') differs from the standard rule in § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X for genuine German social-insurance authorities, which currently uses the third day after posting; this fictitious insurer's wording was followed as printed, but if this were a real Rentenversicherungsträger the standard 3-day rule would apply instead, shifting the deadline one day earlier (21.12.2026).

The exact date the letter was actually handed to the postal service ('Aufgabe zur Post') is not stated separately in the letter; the document date (18.11.2026) was assumed as the posting date, which could shift the deadline if posting happened later.
No amounts, payments, or contract terms are mentioned in this letter — it is a rejection of a disability pension application with a recommendation to contact the Agentur für Arbeit.
